title: DNA extraction from soil
author: Tsu-Chun Hung
materials: Measuring 250 mg for a soil sample

steps.title: Add beads and buffers to tube
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 1 mm beads, then 200 µL of 0.5 mm beads, 225 µL of TE buffer (kept at 4 °C), and 375 µL of lysis buffer (kept at 4 °C) to a 2 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Add soil sample
steps.instruction: Transfer the soil sample into the same 2 mL Eppendorf tube (outside the laminar flow hood).

steps.title: Crush sample in mixmill
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a mixmill and run at 30 rpm for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 17.0 × g, 25 °C for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare deep‑well plate reagents
steps.instruction: Add reagents to the 96‑deep‑well plate as follows.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 µL of isopropanol to well 1.
Add 125 µL of magnetic beads (10 mg/mL) to well 1; shake the bottle and pipette before use.
Add 200 µL of the lysate (from the centrifuged tube) to well 1 (add last).
Add 400 µL of isopropanol to well 2.
Add 300 µL of 80 % ethanol to well 3.
Add 300 µL of 80 % ethanol to well 4.
Add 100 µL of double‑distilled water to well 5.

steps.title: Run automated extraction
steps.instruction: Place the prepared 96‑deep‑well plate into the automated DNA extraction machine and run the program.

steps.title: Collect eluted DNA
steps.instruction: After the run, pipette 100 µL of the eluted sample and keep it as DNA template for downstream experiments.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: In a new 2 mL Eppendorf tube, add 250 µL of 0.133 M ammonium acetate, then transfer 300 µL of the supernatant from the centrifuged lysate (step 4) into this tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL of 0.133 M ammonium acetate.
Transfer 300 µL of supernatant from step 4.

steps.title: Incubate on ice (first)
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on ice for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Add aluminium sulfate
steps.instruction: In another 2 mL Eppendorf tube, add 200 µL of 0.06 M aluminium sulfate.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to aluminium sulfate tube
steps.instruction: Transfer 500 µL of the supernatant from step 10 into the tube containing aluminium sulfate (step 11).

steps.title: Incubate on ice (second)
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on ice for 10 minutes.
